content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: LLB degree; Enrolled as an Advocate under the Advocates Act, 1961 Experience: Category A: Designated Sr. Advocates with more than 15 years of regular practice. Category B: Sr. Counsel/AoR with more than 10 years. Category C: Junior Advocates/AoR with 5-10 years. Other conditions: Applicants must be empanelled for the listed courts only: Allahabad High Court, CAT Allahabad, CESTAT Allahabad, CGIT Lucknow, State Consumer Commission Lucknow, and the district-level courts in the UP (West) Circle Multiple applications from one applicant: only the latest is considered Desirable: Experience in telecom law, TRAI/TDSAT matters, service matters, arbitration, IBC and taxation Experience in handling CPSE/Government/PSU cases

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for BSNL Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Advocates blacklisted or debarred by any Govt./PSU Advocates with pending disciplinary proceedings

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Fees are paid as per the Ministry of Law & Justice fee schedule dated 05.02.2026. No retainership fee is paid unless the advocate is appointed Standing Counsel or Retainer Counsel. Initial empanelment for 2 years or until further orders Renewable for 1 more year on satisfactory performance Performance reviewed quarterly Empanelment gives no right to allocation of cases Empanelled advocates are not BSNL employees

content_sections.heading: How Will BSNL Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Empanelment Committee assesses the bio-data and documents on objective criteria Weighted scoring on experience, domain expertise, Govt/PSU case experience, track record, financial standing, interview performance and past BSNL performance Final approval by the competent authority (CGM at Circle level) Weighted scoring: professional experience 20-25%, domain expertise 15-20%, Govt/PSU cases 10-15%, track record 15-20%, financial standing 5-10%, interview 10-15%, past BSNL performance 10-15%

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Bar Council enrolment certificate and identity card List of other organisations where the advocate is on panel Details of BSNL cases handled LLB degree certificate Reported judgments Income Tax Returns for the last 3 years Undertaking that the information is correct and no disciplinary proceedings are pending

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BSNL Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Read Annexure-I (guidelines), Annexure-II (fee schedule), Annexure-III (bio-data format) and Annexure VI-A (terms and conditions). Fill the bio-data in the Annexure-III format with a recent photograph. Attach self-attested copies of the required documents. Send the completed form so that it reaches the AGM (Legal), BSNL UP (West) Telecom Circle, Meerut, on or before 16-11-2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: BSNL may accept or reject any application, or cancel the empanelment process, at any stage False or misleading information leads to cancellation The panel is not exhaustive; BSNL may engage non-panel advocates in important cases

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for BSNL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How do I apply for BSNL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Annexure-III (Bio-data format) in the notice) and send it to Assistant General Manager (Legal), O/o CGMT, BSNL UP (West) Telecom Circle, Shastri Nagar Telephone Exchange Building, Tejgarhi Chauraha, Garh Road, Meerut - 250004, by application must reach the address on or before the last date, to reach by 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary for BSNL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fees per the Ministry of Law & Justice fee schedule dated 05.02.2026. No fixed salary.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: LLB degree and enrolment as an Advocate with a Bar Council. Regular practice of 5 years or more, depending on the category.

faq.question: Q5. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Applicants must be empanelled for the listed courts only: Allahabad High Court, CAT Allahabad, CESTAT Allahabad, CGIT Lucknow, State Consumer Commission Lucknow, and the district-level courts in the UP (West) Circle. Multiple applications from one applicant: only the latest is considered.

faq.question: Q6. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Advocates blacklisted or debarred by any Govt./PSU. Advocates with pending disciplinary proceedings.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Empanelment Committee assesses the bio-data and documents on objective criteria. Weighted scoring on experience, domain expertise, Govt/PSU case experience, track record, financial standing, interview performance and past BSNL performance. Final approval by the competent authority (CGM at Circle level). Weighted scoring: professional experience 20-25%, domain expertise 15-20%, Govt/PSU cases 10-15%, track record 15-20%, financial standing 5-10%, interview 10-15%, past BSNL performance 10-15%.

faq.question: Q8. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Initial empanelment for 2 years or until further orders. Renewable for 1 more year on satisfactory performance. Performance reviewed quarterly.

faq.question: Q9. Which places are covered by BSNL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Agra, Aligarh, Amroha, Auriya, Baghpat, Bareilly, Badaun.

faq.question: Q10. Which documents are needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Bar Council enrolment certificate and identity card; List of other organisations where the advocate is on panel; Details of BSNL cases handled; LLB degree certificate; Reported judgments; Income Tax Returns for the last 3 years.
